{{Quote|Greetings, citizen. Happy Empire Day to you.|Commander Pex, to an Empire Day participant|<ref name="SWG:HED" />}}
'''Pex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a public relations [[Officer/Legends|officer]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Greetings Citizens of the Empire, as chief public relations officer I greet you in the name of the Emperor and pass his best wishes to you on this special day. Each year since the Galactic Senate in its infinite wisdom entrusted the government of the galaxy to the impeccable guidance of the Emperor Palpatine, Empire day has been a cause for Celebration..|Commander Pex|<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref>}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Pex served as Chief Public Relations Officer of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="FF" /> During the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities<ref name="SWG:HED" /> of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he resided in a hotel at the city of [[Nashal]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was here that he instructed an Imperial spacer to visit an [[Unidentified Imperial garrison historian|Imperial garrison historian]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], to help him collect data for a report he was writing. The mission eventually led the spacer to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] at [[Outpost GRF-7493]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:HED" />

==Behind the scenes==
An "Imperial PR officer" appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial PR officer was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="FF" /> he could be found in Nashal and started a quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Happy Empire Day!|Happy Empire Day!]]," which would send players on an important mission throughout the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:HED" /> The web article "[https://web.archive.org/web/20051015222320/http://starwarsgalaxies.station.sony.com/content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day Friday Feature - Empire Day]" on the official ''Star Wars Galaxies'' website introduced the Empire Day live event to players and clearly identified the "Imperial PR officer" from the game as "Chief Public Relations Officer Commander Pex".<ref name="FF" /> After the live event ended, Pex never reappeared in the game since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>
